<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
    <key>Label</key><string>com.study-stash.server</string>
    <key>ProgramArguments</key>
    <array>
        <string>/opt/Study Stash/studystash</string>
        <string>--home</string>
        <string>/home/student/.study-stash</string>
        <string>run</string>
    </array>
    <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
    <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
    <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/home/student/.study-stash/logs/server.log</string>
    <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/home/student/.study-stash/logs/server.log</string>
    <key>EnvironmentVariables</key>
    <dict>
        <key>PATH</key><string>/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/home/student/.local/bin</string>
        <key>STUDYSTASH_SERVICE</key><string>1</string>
    </dict>
</dict>
</plist>

services.systemd:
[Unit]
Description=Study Stash library

[Service]
ExecStart="/opt/Study Stash/studystash" --home /home/student/.study-stash run
Environment=STUDYSTASH_SERVICE=1
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

[Unit]
Description=Study Stash library

[Service]
ExecStart="/opt/a&b <c>/studystash" --home "/home/student/x & y" client run
Environment=STUDYSTASH_SERVICE=1
Restart=always
RestartSec=10

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

firewall.script: Remove-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Study Stash library' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'Study Stash library' -Description 'Lets your laptop reach your Study Stash library. Added by Study Stash setup.' -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 8790 -RemoteAddress 100.64.0.0/10,LocalSubnet -Profile Any | Out-Null; $py = @('C:\Program Files\Study Stash\studystash.exe','C:\Users\it''s me\studystash.exe'); Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter | Where-Object { $py -contains $_.Program } | Get-NetFirewallRule | Where-Object { $_.Direction -eq 'Inbound' -and $_.Action -eq 'Block' } | Remove-NetFirewallRule
firewall.elevate: try { Start-Process powershell -Verb RunAs -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-EncodedCommand',''; exit 0 } catch { exit 1 }
